representation: Canonical tagged tuple with explicit runtime-semantics/value profiles, ordered imports, all structure/inductive layouts and declaration signatures including generic binders, parameter names/types and result types. Declaration bodies are the sole omitted IR field.
inputBinding: The production graph projects its actual archived VerifiedIR into a runtime-interface ArtifactId, records a separate pass, retains the exact bytes and exposes the identity in the checked receipt. Input validity still depends on the separately recorded strict validator.
fingerprint: The domain/schema/contract-qualified artifact key is an exact fingerprint of this projection. Body-only edits preserve it; any encoded signature, layout, import, order or profile change invalidates it. All declarations/layouts are retained conservatively; visibility is not inferred.
offlineReplay: The observed archive verifier recomputes this specific projection against exact archived input/output bytes. A fully rehashed false projection is rejected even when the consumer independently pins its graph. Other semantic claims and preservation remain unverified.
remaining: bind per-source-module rather than combined runtime-module interfaces
global adequacy and incremental correctness proofs
